Action: # Blank lines and any line whose Action column starts with '#' are ignored.
#   Action        - name of the action reported via OnAction
#   Set           - action-set name; only bindings whose Set is enabled (via EnableSet) are evaluated.
#   Event         - Down | Up | Click | Hold - which transition of Expr fires the action event.
#   Expr          - one or more terms joined by '&' (AND). Term format: SIDE.CONTROL[.STATE]
#                               or <FeatureName>:<Kind> to reference any OpenXR device feature by name (see below).
#                                        Value>=f | Value<=f | X>=f | X<=f | Y>=f | Y<=f | Z>=f | Z<=f | Mag>=f | Mag<=f
#   Lets a term reference ANY OpenXR device feature reported for the device - not just the
#   built-in CONTROL names above. Use this for hardware-specific features (e.g. Valve Index's
#   GripForce). Run the game once with the controller connected and check the log for
#   "device feature(s)" entries to find the exact FeatureName and its type.
#     FeatureName - the literal name reported in the log (e.g. GripForce).
#     Kind        - Bool | Axis1D | Axis2D | Axis3D - matches the feature's reported type
#     R.GripForce:Axis1D.Value>=0.5      -> true while GripForce is at least 0.5
#     R.GripForce:Axis1D                 -> Pressed/Down/Up/Held using the row's Threshold column

Set: Pressed/Down/Up/Held REQUIRE the Threshold column to be set
